ablation_policy: After primary configurations are frozen, refit the selected SPOT_PLUS_ALL configuration for each family on SPOT_PLUS_FUNDING/OI/FUTURES_FLOW/BASIS without retuning. These component ablations are secondary and cannot change primary model selection.
claim_scope: Predictive information only; no causal interpretation.

features.complete_case_rule: Use identical rows for every information set: all 10 features finite at each of t-5 through t, and the full future target window finite. No imputation.

information_sets.SPOT_ONLY: six lags of the six frozen spot features
information_sets.SPOT_PLUS_ALL_DERIVATIVES: SPOT_ONLY plus six lags of all four frozen derivatives features

features.information_timing: features through interval t only; targets begin at t+1

interpretation: A predictive improvement indicates incremental out-of-sample information under this sample/split; it does not establish causality or market-wide generalization.
leakage_controls: Inputs at t include only certified features from intervals t-5 through t; each target begins at t+1.
No target window crosses a train/validation split; train labels end strictly before validation starts.
All preprocessing is fitted within each training fold; missing values are not imputed.
The final test values are not parsed during protocol design or model tuning.
No feature selection, target threshold, or scaling statistic uses final-test observations.
The equal-weight ensemble is formed only from development OOF predictions; no in-sample stacking.
All information-set comparisons use the exact same complete-case rows.

excluded_families.reason: The effective sample is about 3.2k development rows per asset/task; larger sequence models have an unfavorable parameter-to-sample ratio and are not needed beyond a small GRU.
HistGradientBoosting provides a maintained tree-boosting benchmark without another dependency or materially expanding the bounded model comparison.
The sample and number of temporal folds do not justify a fitted meta learner; an equal-weight ensemble uses only development OOF predictions and has no extra tuning.
Unbounded search would invalidate comparable tuning budgets and encourage selection on validation noise.

model_design.fairness: Same rows, folds, transformations, scoring, test period, and three-configuration budget for each tunable family and each primary information set.

configs.rule: future RV = current RV*sqrt(h); future downside = current downside*h; future Amihud = current Amihud
mean log1p target in that training fold
unweighted mean of selected OOF predictions from Ridge, RBF_SVR, ExtraTrees, HistGradientBoosting, MLP, GRU; no fitted meta learner

model_design.preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted within each training fold for linear, kernel, MLP and GRU models. Tree models receive training-fold-scaled features too for a uniform pipeline. No imputation, feature selection, or global normalization.
model_design.primary_metric: MAE on log1p(target); lower is better. All model/information-set comparisons use the same target rows.
secondary_metrics: MAE and RMSE on original scale
QLIKE on future realized variance (RV target squared)

practical_magnitude: At least 1% mean relative reduction in log-MAE at the task level; report absolute and relative deltas regardless.

prediction_targets.classification: Not selected. The primary question is incremental continuous predictive accuracy; event classification would require a training-fold threshold and adds a second estimand. No class imbalance applies to these regression tasks.
prediction_targets.sample: 4-hour UTC panel; development dates through 2023-06-30 20:00 UTC; final test feature dates from 2023-07-01 00:00 UTC.

targets.unit: scaled Amihud proxy averaged over future window

primary_robustness_rule.asset_replication: Call a target/horizon replicated only if the task-level rule passes separately for both BTC and ETH.
primary_robustness_rule.broad_incremental: Replicated task-level evidence in at least two distinct targets and at least two horizons.
primary_robustness_rule.inconclusive: Material pipeline/coverage failure or block uncertainty too wide to distinguish practical improvement from deterioration.
primary_robustness_rule.model_sensitive: Only one model category supports an improvement, or evidence is isolated and fails replication.
primary_robustness_rule.no_robust_value: Adequate test coverage and uncertainty, but no task meets task-level rule.
primary_robustness_rule.nonlinear_value: At least two nonlinear categories (kernel, bagging, boosting, neural) support positive improvements while linear does not meet task-level support.
primary_robustness_rule.task_level: positive average relative log-MAE reduction in at least 4 of 6 family categories; Holm-adjusted paired bootstrap p<0.05 in at least 2 independent categories; mean relative reduction at least 1%; and no two categories show statistically supported deterioration.

question: Does adding certified derivatives history improve out-of-sample prediction of future spot risk/liquidity beyond spot history?
stopping_rule: After one final test evaluation, paired uncertainty, prespecified ablations and development-based interpretability, stop. No new model/feature/horizon or protocol changes.

temporal_cv.design: 3 expanding-origin walk-forward development folds; no random CV
temporal_cv.purge: Training labels must end strictly before validation start; validation labels must end before validation block end. Thus no overlapping future target crosses a split boundary.
temporal_cv.test: Untouched feature timestamps 2023-07-01 through 2024-03-03 20:00 UTC; future windows truncated at the certified sample boundary.
temporal_cv.tuning: Each tunable model gets exactly 3 fixed configurations on the same 3 folds for SPOT_ONLY and SPOT_PLUS_ALL_DERIVATIVES; choose minimum pooled validation log-MAE. No final-test use.

uncertainty.method: paired moving-block bootstrap on final-test prediction rows
uncertainty.multiplicity: Holm-adjust paired bootstrap p-values within each asset x target x horizon family across model categories.
uncertainty.paired: same sampled temporal indices for Spot Only and Spot+Derivatives
